title: One step of an existing workflow page changes
turns: I'm tidying up my Sunday meal-prep routine. Can you pull up what I have written for it?

Okay. One change: I'm no longer ordering the groceries on Saturday afternoon, because the delivery slots are gone by then. From now on I place the order on Friday evening. Everything else in the routine stays as it is.

answer_key.reference: The person changed one step of the Sunday meal-prep routine: the grocery order is now placed on Friday evening instead of Saturday afternoon, because the Saturday delivery slots are gone by then. Step 3 of the routine page should say Friday evening; every other step and section stays as written. The pantry-check page and the Batch Cooking page do not change.
